description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
summary: Your profileMachine Learning EngineerTurba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA A…
description:
Your profileMachine Learning EngineerTurba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA
A scheduling idea that works in a notebook is a rumor until it survives a client's cluster. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it, and it has to work on infrastructure we do not control.
Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? You make what we build reliable enough for a data center to depend on.
What you will own
Research to production. Take a validated idea into the Scheduler: design it, build it, test it, roll it out, monitor it, and own what happens after.
The ML platform's architecture. The decisions others build on, including when a learned approach earns its operational cost over a simple heuristic.
Training, evaluation and benchmarking pipelines. Every scheduling policy and performance model reproducible and comparable, so progress is measured, not argued.
GPU-level reality. Profile and optimize workloads and models on heterogeneous hardware, and feed what you measure back into the Simulator.
Safe…

description:
Your profileData Scientist & ResearcherTurba Labs · Heidelberg (Germany) or San Francisco Bay Area (USA) · On-site, hybrid or remote · Full-time · Candidates must live in Germany or the USA
AI infrastructure is no longer uniform. Data centers now run mixed clusters of GPU generations, vendors and accelerators, and the software that schedules work on them was mostly built for uniform hardware. Turba Labs is building what replaces it.
Two products. The Scheduler runs live on our clients' infrastructure and decides which workload runs on which GPU, and when. The Simulator answers a related question before a data center spends a cent: given a planned build-out, what is the best way to use it? Both are only as good as the science underneath. You are that science.
What you will own
The scheduling brain. Policies that place and sequence workloads across heterogeneous GPUs, from sharp heuristics to optimization to reinforcement learning, whichever one actually wins on real data.
The Simulator's truth. Performance, cost and utilization models accurate enough that a data center bases a hardware purchase on them, and a running measure of how far they drift from what the Scheduler sees in production.
The signal in live cluster data. Where capacity is lost, why, and what to test next.
The research agenda. Decide which questions matter, kill the ones that don't, and take the survivors from hypothesis to something our engineers ship.

Ready to own it, build it, and grow it?

The Mission:

Publitas lets people, and increasingly agents, create, host and distribute digital flyers and catalogues for retail brands. Our customers include ALDI, IKEA, Carrefour, Metro and Decathlon. Right now we’re building a fully automatic, agentic workflow that generates a whole catalogue from a brand guide and a list of products.

You’ll join a team of senior engineers who are put on our hardest problems, some of which cut across teams. Our customer base is large (not Google scale, but big), so what you ship gets used, and it comes with real technical challenges. Our core stack is Ruby on Rails on the backend and JavaScript with React on the frontend, with services around it in JavaScript, TypeScript and Python. This is a staff-level role, and you’ll have a lot of influence in a mid-sized company with very little red tape.

You've built several complete products and you'd enjoy showing them to us.

Lynker, a Federal Government Contractor, is seeking to fill a full-time position supporting the National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP) at the Space Weather Prediction Center (SWPC). Space Weather refers to variations in the space environment between the sun and Earth that can affect technologies in space and on Earth. Space weather is primarily driven by solar storm phenomena that include coronal mass ejections, solar flares, solar particle events and solar wind. These phenomena that are directed toward Earth are potential drivers of space weather events that can disrupt communications, satellite and airline operations, navigation and surveying systems, as well as electric power grids across large geographic regions on Earth. Space weather is a global issue and an understanding of solar storm phenomena is an important component to SWPC’s success at developing accurate space weather forecasts (event onset, location, duration, and magnitude).

Wir arbeiten nah an unseren Kund:innen, mit kurzen Wegen und viel Eigenverantwortung im Team.
Die Rolle
Wir suchen ab sofort eine Manager:in Personal Branding & CEO-Kommunikation (m/w/d) in Vollzeit in Hamburg. Du verantwortest Personal Branding und CEO-Kommunikation für Gründer:innen und Geschäftsführer:innen unserer Kund:innen – auf LinkedIn, in den Medien und auf Bühnen.
Du bist Sparringspartner:in von Foundern, findest ihre Themen und ihre Stimme und sorgst dafür, dass sie sichtbar werden.

Du leitest Kick-off-Strategieworkshops, analysierst, wie Founder und CEOs heute wahrgenommen werden, vergleichst sie mit relevanten Wettbewerber:innen und entwickelst mit ihnen ihre Soll-Positionierung: Kernthemen, Tonalität, Kanäle, Formate.

summary: Mission Brief   At Isar Aerospace, we are enabling affordable and flexible access to space. As Europe’s leading privately funded launch company, we are developing and operating launch vehicles that…
description:
Mission Brief 

At Isar Aerospace, we are enabling affordable and flexible access to space. As Europe’s leading privately funded launch company, we are developing and operating launch vehicles that provide reliable access to orbit for commercial and institutional customers worldwide. 

To support the continued development and operation of our launch systems, we are looking for a (Senior) Flight Safety Engineer to take ownership of flight safety engineering activities across vehicle development, licensing, and launch operations. In this role, you will drive the flight safety framework for our launch vehicles and act as a key interface between engineering, regulatory authorities, and launch range partners. 

As a (Senior) Flight Safety Engineer in the Mission and Launch operations team, you will work at the intersection of engineering, risk analysis and mission operations. In that frame, you will ensure that our launch systems meet the highest standards of safety, reliability, and regulatory compliance throughout the vehicle lifecycle. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission 

Own system-level flight safety engineering activities for launch vehicle development and operations.  

Define, manage, and verify system requirements related to Range Safety Systems (RTS) and Flight Termination Systems (FTS), ensuring compliance with range and regulatory requirements.  

Support mission licensing activities and regulatory approvals, including preparation of safety analyses and compliance…

Mission Brief 

Isar Aerospace is seeking a Senior Computational Engineering Architect to establish and drive the long-term vision, standards, methodologies, and digital infrastructure underpinning engineering analysis across current and future launch vehicle programs. You will be responsible for transforming simulation, modeling, optimization, and digital engineering capabilities into a scalable and strategic company asset, ensuring consistency, traceability, automation, and engineering excellence across all disciplines. 

Working closely with the Chief Engineer, Product Principal Engineers, Systems Engineering, Software Platform Team, Design Teams, and IT functions, you will define the future state of engineering analysis, simulation governance, AI-enabled engineering, and the digital thread across the organization. You will ensure that engineering decisions are supported by robust, repeatable, and validated analytical processes while enabling rapid design iteration, optimization, and technology development. 

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

Own CAE standards and methodology. Define company-wide standards, best practices and verification methods, and keep simulation workflows consistent across CFD, FEA, thermal, acoustics and multiphysics.

Govern tools and licences. Be the technical authority for CAE software: version management, qualification, roadmaps, licensing, vendor relationships, capability planning and utilisation.

title: Senior Embedded Android Engineer- Hardware
summary: Team description  SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our…
description:
Team description

SumUp's Hardware Development team builds the physical products millions of small businesses rely on every day, and this role sits right at the start of a new chapter: moving our in-house hardware onto the Android platform for the first time. This isn't a typical Android device, it's a highly customised, security-first product built from scratch, which means the person joining will help define how the operating system, drivers, and secure processor come together rather than inheriting someone else's setup. The team works closely with hardware, software, and QA engineers across the bring-up process, so this role offers a rare chance to shape a product's foundations while working alongside experienced embedded and secure processor leads.

Please note this role would require relocation to Berlin, Germany.

What you'll do

Support system bring-up for the new Android embedded platform, from bootloader through to kernel and framework

Integrate and maintain kernel modules and drivers, including power management and connectivity components

Contribute to build system integration across the platform

Debug hardware and software issues at the protocol level and help resolve critical issues found during testing

Carry out testing and validation to confirm the platform is stable and secure before release

You'll be great for this role if…

Experience developing embedded systems with a strong focus on Android OS, gained over several years in a professional…

summary: About the team:  You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity…
description:
About the team:

You'll join one of the teams within SumUp's Identity Lifecycle Mission, working on some of the most critical building blocks behind the merchant journey, from onboarding and identity verification to KYC/KYB, regulatory data collection, and managing customer identity throughout the entire lifecycle.

Today, many of these capabilities live across different flows, legacy services, and tightly coupled integrations. We're on a journey to bring these pieces together into a more coherent, scalable platform, with shared data models, reusable services, and clear ownership boundaries.

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you won't just be maintaining existing systems. You'll have the opportunity to shape how our identity platform evolves, modernise critical services, and help build foundations that can support new regulations, markets, and product requirements without reinventing the wheel every time.

You'll be part of one dedicated team, but the challenges we tackle often cross team and domain boundaries. You'll work closely with Engineers, Product, Design, Compliance, Risk, and Operations, giving you the opportunity to influence solutions well beyond your own team.

If you enjoy solving complex backend problems, working in a highly collaborative environment, improving reliability, and building scalable capabilities that enable other teams to move faster, this could be an exciting opportunity to make a real impact at SumUp.

description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager

At Wolt, we create technology that brings local communities, merchants and customers closer together. What started with restaurant delivery has grown into a broader local commerce platform, helping customers discover and access more of what their cities have to offer.

As our Retail business continues to grow, we're looking for a Senior Sales Regional Enterprise Manager to expand our selection of high-value regional retail partners. You'll join our Sales team and take ownership of some of the most important regional acquisition opportunities across priority retail verticals, helping shape what customers can find on Wolt in their cities. This role can be based in Berlin, Cologne, Frankfurt, Hamburg or Munich .

What you'll…

Who we are
At Supermodular AI, we help enterprises navigate AI Transformation. We believe in strategy through execution.
Most organizations understand the potential of AI, but struggle to translate that ambition into real operational change. The challenge is rarely the technology itself. It is how AI fits into complex systems, workflows, and engineering organizations that have evolved over years. We believe AI transformation cannot be designed purely in strategy documents. The real strategy only emerges by building, deploying, and operating AI systems inside the organization.
That's why we work directly with enterprise IT and software teams to design and implement AI systems in real environments. This includes enabling engineering organizations to work in fundamentally new ways by introducing AI-native development practices, frameworks, and technical assets that change how teams build and operate software. It also includes building custom AI systems that unblock difficult modernization or harmonization efforts where traditional approaches have stalled.
Our team has a strong track record of building high-impact AI systems and scaling engineering teams inside complex enterprises. If you enjoy solving hard enterprise problems and turning ambitious ideas into systems that actually run in production, you'll feel at home at Supermodular AI.

description:
About the Role
Our flight-control system is already flying Skyron400. Now we want to make it faster, sharper and more capable. 
As our Senior Flight Control & State Estimation Engineer, you will take technical ownership of the control and estimation capabilities that determine how precisely our interceptor estimates its state, how quickly it reacts and how aggressively it can operate without compromising stability or robustness. 
From advanced estimation and control algorithms to embedded Rust optimization and flight-test analysis, you will set technical direction, make decisions based on real flight data and drive measurable improvements in aircraft performance. 

What is your Day to Day Mission:
Take technical ownership of flight-control and state-estimation architecture, priorities and validation. 

Improve state estimation using Kalman filters, IIM, particle filters and model based approaches. 

Fuse IMU, radar, camera and ToF data into robust vehicle and target-state estimates. 

Increase the accuracy of velocity and position estimation in GPS-denied environments. 

Optimize sensor filtering, synchronization, outlier rejection and latency compensation. 

Own the design, implementation and tuning of flight-control algorithms for maximum agility, precision and stability. 

Identify real flight dynamics from recorded data and use them to improve models, estimators and controllers. 

Improve sensor and vehicle models used in simulation, SIL and HIL environments.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.

Dit is jouw uitdaging
Iedere maand vragen we tussen de 6000 en 7500 bedrijven in Nederland naar hun verwachtingen voor de omzet van hun bedrijf. Bij elkaar verzameld en gemiddeld blijkt dit een goede voorspelling voor de omzetontwikkeling van bedrijfstakken. We willen graag deze link ook op microniveau leggen en inzichtelijk maken voor verschillende doeleinden:
Het publiceren van ondersteunende informatie voor gebruikers van onze enquête om deze beter te kunnen interpreteren en gebruiken voor voorspellingen.

Het gebruiken van deze informatie om 'verdachte opgaven' in enquêtes later in het proces te ontdekken.

Een eerder (kort) onderzoek leverde verwarrende resultaten op waarbij de verbanden tussen verwachting en omzet niet duidelijk te zien waren. We hebben echter de bevestiging dat vergelijkbare onderzoeken in andere landen wel gelukt zijn. Het is dus waarschijnlijk dat we hier nog zaken gemist hebben. Dit is jouw eerste uitdaging! 
Vervolgens ga je op zoek naar antwoorden op de volgende vragen:
Hoe kunnen we deze data zo beschikbaar maken dat externe onderzoekers hier optimaal nut uit kunnen halen?

Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen.

Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden
LOGEX ontvangt elke maand data vanuit ziekenhuizen. Wij hebben een grotendeels geautomatiseerd proces om op basis van de data van het ziekenhuis periodieke analyses uit te voeren en de resultaten op te leveren aan de klant. Elke oplevering kent echter ook maatwerk:
Is de data correct ingeladen?

Zijn de uitkomsten betrouwbaar?

Zijn alle onderdelen van het interactieve dashboard goed gevuld?

Sluiten de cijfers tussen de detailinformatie in het interactieve dashboard op elkaar aan?

Welke aandachtspunten moeten we communiceren richting het ziekenhuis?

Jouw rol is om het gehele proces te bewaken van de data aanlevering tot de uitkomsten in het interactieve dashboard. Jij zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat alle ziekenhuizen periodiek inzicht hebben in hun financiële resultaten.

Het Financial Analytics-team – momenteel ~40 mensen – groeit snel en is in volle gang. Het team is primair verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van financiële planning en controle van ziekenhuizen door hen met tools te ondersteunen bij o.a. duurzame portfoliobeslissingen,…

description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. Every email, push notification and in-app message we send should feel like it was written for the person reading it, not for us. Right now, nobody owns that.
That’s where you come in. As our Copywriter, you will own every message our users get across email, push and in-app, plus the updates they read when something goes wrong. AI will write most of the first drafts. You’ll build the system that writes them, judge what it gets wrong, and add the creative edge AI always misses.

Take Ownership 🚀
You’ll own the words our users read every day. Here’s how you’ll do it:
Build, maintain and improve AI copywriting agents for email, push and in-app, and feed your edits back in so their output keeps getting better. 

Turn every draft into copy that starts from the user’s world, not ours (“your rate just jumped to 3.01%” instead of “we increased your rate”), with hooks, subject lines and tone that make people act. 

Own the moments that matter most, from the messages users see before they leave to incident banners and status page updates, and write the one-off copy the system can’t produce.

 Your English is fluent at a professional level, and your grammar and spelling are spotless. Native or near-native is a plus.

You’ve built or improved AI agents or prompts that produce copy, and you know how to fix them when the output drifts.

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Our Global Markets Growth & Business Operations team is growing. Our goal is to accelerate growth in our managed countries and to turn each country's ambition into a plan that gets delivered. We work closely with Brand Marketing, Growth Marketing, Product, Communications, Supply, Policy and Finance teams, both central and local, to develop growth levers, streamline operations, and drive impact for countries.

The Difference You Will Make

We are looking for someone to own and scale the growth operations capability for our global markets. You will set the direction for how we identify, pilot and scale new levers that capture growth country by country, and you will hold the organization accountable to deliver. This is a high-visibility role where your influence comes from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilize teams across a global matrix.

You will partner with Growth Marketing, Brand Marketing, Finance, Product and country leadership to build playbooks that can be implemented across markets, and you will shape the annual country plans and the central Global Markets…

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Customer Activation Manager, you’ll partner with our largest customers to accelerate adoption, realize value, and strengthen their long-term success with Figma. As part of our Customer Success and Solutions org, you’ll lead clearly defined, short-term engagements spanning Enterprise onboarding, Governance+ activation, AI activation, and focused risk mitigation for customers whose health signals indicate potential churn or contraction. You’ll work closely with Customer Success leadership to evolve our activation strategy and build key cross-functional relationships to deliver an exceptional customer experience. You’ll use metrics, customer feedback, and direct experience to identify opportunities to improve adoption, address barriers to value, and strengthen customer health. You are an excellent communicator and project manager with a passion for customers, and we can’t wait to meet you!

This is a full-time, hybrid role based out of our São Paulo hub.

description:
Our Mission
At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.
We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role
You will be the first engineer on our Simulation team. Every site we map becomes a digital twin, built from our own lidar maps, and in it our robots see thousands of the intrusions, fires and sensor failures a real site sees once a year. Our multi-robot patrol policy was trained in simulation in under two hours on a single GPU and ran unmodified on real robots at three sites. Your job is to make that repeatable for every site and every new skill.
You will work with our Skills & Orchestration engineers, who train learned skills with reinforcement learning, and with our Reliability & Test Infrastructure engineer, who runs regression in the same simulator.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

The Role
You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds.
Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers.

About Stripe

Stripe builds financial infrastructure for businesses—from ambitious startups to global enterprises. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we’re building the tools that help businesses participate in and grow the global economy.

About the team

Stripe’s Crypto team is building financial infrastructure for a world where money moves as easily as information. Across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy, we help businesses build products powered by stablecoins, wallets, and programmable money movement.

Open Issuance is central to that opportunity. Built by Bridge, a Stripe company, it enables businesses to launch and manage their own stablecoins. Alongside it, Open Standard—the independent organization behind Open USD (OUSD)—is building a shared stablecoin network with broad distribution and economics designed to benefit the businesses driving adoption. 

We’re hiring one of the founding sellers of our Open Issuance go-to-market team. You’ll partner closely with Open Standard and teams across Stripe, Bridge, and Privy on a major strategic bet: challenging the stablecoin duopoly and giving businesses more choice, control, and participation in the economics of digital dollars.

This is an opportunity to help build a market—not simply sell into an established one.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

About the Role

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
About Us

Metronome is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, now a Stripe product, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.

Our platform computes hundreds of millions of invoices per billing period and continues to scale rapidly to accommodate new customers. We save them days of development time and manual invoicing, enabling them to use their billing data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, Anthropic, NVIDIA, TogetherAI, HuggingFace, and many others.

You'll be joining an experienced team that includes founders who have successfully built and sold startups before. Our Stripes have direct experience building and scaling teams through massive growth at companies like Dropbox, Palantir, and MongoDB. You'll be joining Stripe and be part of the holistic Stripe platform approaching monetization.

About the Role

The Metronome AI Native Solutions team operates at the intersection of technical sales, implementation, and customer success, purpose-built for the velocity and unique needs of AI-first companies. Unlike traditional sales engineering roles, this position owns the large parts of if not all of the deal cycle - from first call through technical win - and gets hands-on with implementation to ensure customers go live quickly.
